summary: Stub package beacons installer host metadata to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint on install and require
details: The package presents itself as a 'compatibility shim' but ships no functional code — index.js exports a Proxy of no-op getters. Its only effect is a beacon: beacon.cjs POSTs a JSON payload containing the package name, os.hostname(), the install path (__dirname), process.cwd(), and process.version to a hardcoded bare-IP HTTP endpoint at http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc. The beacon is wired to the package.json postinstall hook so it fires automatically on `npm install`, and index.js also triggers it on require(), so loading the module as a dependency re-sends the identifiers. The destination is an unencrypted bare IP unrelated to any declared publisher, and the collected fields are host-identifying installer metadata with no relation to any advertised functionality.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
